top_categories.workout_context: At mile 60 of 80, glycogen is gone. This workout teaches your body to produce watts on fumes.
81ft/mi signals a climbing-heavy course. Sustained sub-threshold and threshold work builds the steady power needed without turning the opening climb into the day’s hardest effort.

Alpe Gran Fondo's paved Alpine gran fondo rewards road-specific control. Practice smooth gear and cadence changes, accelerate deliberately out of corners, and settle quickly back into sustainable power for 80 miles.
At Alpe Gran Fondo, changes in grade or pace can lift effort above threshold before it settles again. Over-unders train that transition while you keep riding.
6,562ft of climbing makes aerobic ceiling relevant when the grade or pace changes. VO2max work supports those hard moments; sustained climbing and conservative pacing remain the spine.
Race-pace efforts that mimic Alpe Gran Fondo's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before May.
Every hard session works better with a bigger aerobic base. At 80 miles, base fitness is the difference between racing and surviving.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of Alpe Gran Fondo. Train it until it feels boring.
6,562ft of climbing on grades that change every minute. You need to switch from seated to standing without losing rhythm.
Brief efforts above sustainable power can come from grade changes, positioning, or closing a gap at Alpe Gran Fondo. Train them without letting those efforts derail the longer pacing plan.
The aerobic base that lets you ride paved Alpine gran fondo at tempo for 80 miles without cracking. No shortcuts.
Two threshold sessions per week without the recovery cost of VO2max work. For 80 miles, sustainable FTP gains matter more than peak power.

race_overlay.heat: May in Kamnik, Slovenia can bring heat. If the forecast warrants it, include controlled heat exposure before Alpe Gran Fondo and rehearse the drinking and electrolyte plan you tolerate in training. Do not introduce a fixed sodium protocol solely from this preview.
race_overlay.nutrition: Target 60–80g carbs/hour for Alpe Gran Fondo’s 80 miles. Start fueling within the first 30 minutes — early fueling prevents late-race collapse. Bonking at mile 60 is a nutrition failure, not a fitness failure.
race_overlay.altitude: Altitude may change sustainable power and recovery at Alpe Gran Fondo. Use conservative pacing and test any travel strategy before the event.
race_overlay.terrain: The course profile at Alpe Gran Fondo rewards specific practice. Include regular rides on paved alpine gran fondo to build confidence.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on Durability, TT Threshold, and Road Specific to prepare you for 80 miles of paved alpine gran fondo in Kamnik, Slovenia.
